originality.rationale: A strict 4-state model demonstrates that the 2026 sufficient condition cannot imply the converse: the proposed necessary-and-sufficient join-generated condition captures strictly more validating frames. The primary source explicitly states only sufficiency in Proposition 1; the original separate 2024 modal semantics uses non-inclusive verification, hence does not entail this characterization. Targeted published searches and previous research claims showed no equivalent theorem. Residual risk remains from possible general join-operator theory under other terminology.

value.rationale: The motivating paper identifies the stronger local pointwise permission condition as sufficient. A frame-validity iff and minimal strict counterexample provide a natural structural completion of that result. The four-state census shows that the distinction excludes 4,032 valid relations of 65,536, not a degenerate one-off example. It gives an explicit all-size local criterion plus \(O(n^4)\) finite decision method, with direct utility for identifying exact-distribution frames. The significance is the necessary-and-sufficient characterization, not code/reproducibility alone.
